title: Viva Glint: Copilot admin configuration assistant for how-to guidance
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, guidance-only boundaries and documented Copilot access command are supported by the current sources. The assertion that administrators are usually HR or people-analytics staff is unsupported; smaller corrections should name the underlying Glint subscription and complete the access-control path.

claims.where: What's changing; Open questions; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The roadmap says the feature is only available to Viva Glint users with Admin permissions.
claims.quote: Only available for Viva Glint users with Admin permissions.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans an embedded Copilot conversational assistant that answers configuration and how-to questions with step-by-step guidance.
claims.quote: A Copilot-powered conversational assistant embedded in the Viva Glint admin experience that answers configuration and how-to questions and provides step-by-step guidance.

claims.claim: The roadmap says responses include deep links to configuration pages.
claims.quote: Responses will include deep links to configuration pages streamlining navigation and discoverability.

claims.claim: Learn calls the embedded Copilot experience the Viva Glint admin configuration assistant.
claims.quote: The Viva Glint admin configuration assistant is an AI-powered experience, built on Microsoft Copilot, that is embedded directly in the Viva Glint admin experience.

claims.claim: Administrators can ask configuration questions in plain language and receive step-by-step guidance.
claims.quote: Ask in plain language—for example, "How do I add missing survey takers?"—and the assistant will guide you to the right steps and settings.

claims.claim: Answers include source attribution and links to the Microsoft Learn documentation on which they are based.
claims.quote: Every answer is grounded in trusted sources and includes source attribution so you can verify the guidance.

claims.claim: The assistant opens in a collapsible side pane similar to Copilot in Microsoft Edge and Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote: The assistant opens in a collapsible side pane, similar to Copilot in Microsoft Edge and Microsoft Teams.

claims.claim: Suggested prompts adapt to the current admin page.
claims.quote: The configuration assistant surfaces suggested prompts that adapt to the admin page you're on, so relevant questions are one click away.

claims.claim: An entered question can contain up to 500 characters.
claims.quote: Select one of the suggested prompts, or type your own question in the entry field (up to 500 characters).

claims.claim: The assistant provides guidance only and makes no changes to the tenant, programs, users, data or settings.
claims.quote: The Viva Glint admin configuration assistant provides guidance only. It does not make changes to your tenant, programs, users, data, or settings. You remain in control of every action.

claims.quote: Before you perform actions that are hard to reverse (such as launching a survey, updating confidentiality settings, changing user data, or deleting content), review the steps carefully and confirm they match your intent.

claims.claim: The assistant provides thumbs up and thumbs down feedback controls that help improve answer quality.
claims.quote: Use the thumbs up / thumbs down controls to rate a response. Your feedback helps improve answer quality.

claims.claim: Viva Glint admins are often HR or people-analytics staff rather than IT.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint service administrators typically HR people analytics staff IT key roles. Read role-definitions, set-up-user-roles and viva-glint-learning-paths-and-modules excerpts; none establishes which team usually holds admin roles.
claims.fix: Remove 'often HR or people-analytics staff rather than IT' from the first paragraph of Why it matters.

claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Glint admin configuration assistant" "default" "enable". Read copilot-viva-glint-admin, mac-copilot-access, copilot-admin-intro and feature-access-management; none explicitly gives the admin assistant's arrival default.

claims.claim: The assistant is an included option within the existing Viva Glint entitlement.

claims.fix: Keep licensing.model as included. Add to licensing.notes and Cost and licensing: 'Using Viva Glint requires a Viva Suite or Viva Glint subscription plan; no licence specific to the admin configuration assistant is published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/glint-order-teams in sources.

claims.claim: The assistant's Learn page names no separate licence requirement.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint admin configuration assistant license pricing meter subscription plan. Read the full copilot-viva-glint-admin page and glint-order-teams; the assistant page names admin access, not a separate licence.

claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint admin configuration assistant license pricing meter subscription plan. Read copilot-viva-glint-admin in full; it names no meter.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A separate licence, credit rate, meter or charge specific to the assistant is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint admin configuration assistant license pricing meter subscription plan; "Viva Glint admin configuration assistant" "rollout" "license". Read assistant, glint-order-teams, mac-copilot-access and copilot-admin-intro; no assistant-specific terms.

claims.claim: The other Copilot in Viva Glint pages require a licence for Viva Glint, Microsoft Viva Suite or Microsoft Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback.
claims.quote: A license for Viva Glint, Microsoft Viva Suite, or Microsoft Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback is required to access Copilot in Viva Glint.

claims.claim: Those Copilot in Viva Glint pages say a Microsoft Copilot licence is not required.
claims.quote: A license for Microsoft Copilot is not required to access Copilot in Viva Glint.

claims.claim: The org-wide control is reached in Microsoft 365 admin center through Settings > Viva > Viva Glint > Manage settings for Microsoft Copilot in Viva Glint > Org-wide setting > Manage.
claims.quote: Select Settings > Viva. ... Select Viva Glint and choose Manage settings for Microsoft Copilot in Viva Glint. ... select Manage in the Org-wide setting section. ... Choose On.
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path and the rendered table path to 'Settings > Viva > Viva Glint > Manage settings for Microsoft Copilot in Viva Glint > Org-wide setting > Manage > On / Off', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/copilot/mac-copilot-access.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaGlint -FeatureId <featureId> -Name <policyName> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide disabling policy for the selected Glint feature.
claims.quote: Glint | VivaGlint ... Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Reflection -Name UsersAndGroups -IsFeatureEnabled $false ... If you want to disable the feature for all users, use the -Everyone parameter instead.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators, Viva Glint Tenant Administrators and AI Administrators can manage the Copilot access setting.
claims.quote: This feature can be managed by: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators; Viva Glint Tenant Administrators; AI Administrators
claims.fix: Retain the feature-specific roles. Add: 'The general VFAM feature table lists only Global admin for Glint, while the feature-specific access page also lists Viva Glint Tenant Administrators and AI Administrators.' The differing cited page is https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/feature-access-management.

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeature returns feature IDs for use in access policies.
claims.quote: Use the Get-VivaModuleFeature PowerShell cmdlet to get a list of all of the features available in a specific Microsoft 365 app and their associated IDs.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Copilot access policy changes can take up to 24 hours to take effect.
claims.quote: Changes to Copilot access policies in the Microsoft 365 admin center can take up to 24 hours to take effect for users.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises against additional changes to the same policy within 24 hours.
claims.quote: Avoid making additional changes to the same policy within 24 hours of an initial change, as successive changes may not apply as expected.

claims.claim: Custom policies override the organization-wide setting.
claims.quote: Custom policies override the organization-wide setting. Users in groups with an "Off" policy will not have access to Copilot in Viva Glint, even if the organization-wide setting is "On".

claims.where: controls[0].governs and note; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The cited Copilot access and introduction pages describe Highlights and comment summarisation without mentioning the admin assistant or explicitly confirming that the setting governs it.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint admin configuration assistant enable disable default access policy PowerShell switch. Read mac-copilot-access, copilot-admin-intro, feature-access-management and the assistant page; no explicit assistant-to-VFAM mapping.

claims.where: controls[1].ui and controls[1].api; summary; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a separate tenant switch for the admin assistant on either the UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: assistant enable disable default access policy PowerShell switch; "Viva Glint" "configuration assistant" "PowerShell" "FeatureId". Read assistant, mac-copilot-access, manage-access-policies, feature-access-management and Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy.

claims.claim: The assistant's Learn page does not describe rollout mechanics or what an administrator sees before it arrives.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Glint admin configuration assistant" "rollout" "license". Read copilot-viva-glint-admin in full; it describes access to the available assistant, not its deployment mechanism or pre-arrival experience.

claims.claim: Learn gives audience examples but no exhaustive list of Viva Glint roles that see the assistant.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint service administrators typically HR people analytics staff IT key roles. Read assistant, role-definitions and set-up-user-roles excerpts; the assistant names service admins and Admin permissions with examples, not an exhaustive role list.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The checklist asks the reader to take stock of service admin and Admin permissions, but the controls table has no row for those existing role controls.
claims.quote: Identify who holds Viva Glint service admin or Admin permissions ... Table rows: Access to Microsoft Copilot in Viva Glint; A switch for the Viva Glint admin configuration assistant on its own.
claims.fix: The first Before rollout step inventories Viva Glint admin-role access without a corresponding controls row. Remove that checklist bullet; do not add a control row.

claims.claim: Learn says Copilot in Viva Glint is enabled by default, separately from the unanswered default of the admin assistant.
claims.quote: Copilot in Viva Glint is enabled by default. Administrators manage access through Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) in the Microsoft 365 admin center (MAC).
